fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run GuideInstall passes with the three new skill files written with their topic's description and expanded body, and re-running install reports them unchanged; go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... asserts the build index names builder, verifier and build-retry and both their skill and `rhiza guide` routes; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(guide|guide-install|build-evidence-commit)' passes with the new topics in guide ls, the new skill paths in the install output, and build-evidence-commit's fake builder reading the actor-record line from `rhiza guide builder`.
fields.statement: `rhiza guide ls` lists the builder, verifier and build-retry topics, guide install writes them as the rhiza-builder, rhiza-verifier and rhiza-build-retry skills beside the others, and the build topic (still installed as rhiza-build) is a short index that names the three role topics and says which one each role loads, so workflows that still say /rhiza-build or `rhiza guide build` keep working. cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/build-evidence-commit.txtar's fake builder, which greps the topic for the actor-record `git add` line, reads `rhiza guide builder` instead of `rhiza guide build`.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes with the builtin builder and verifier prompt tests updated to the one-line prompts (no checklist, Checks:, session done or test-scope text left in them) and a test that review.toml's verifier prompt equals build.toml's; a test reads .rhiza/workflows/docs-build.toml and .rhiza/workflows/docs-review.toml and asserts each one's verifier prompt equals the builtin one and docs-build's builder prompt starts with the builtin line and keeps the humanize addendum; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(build-evidence-commit|docs-commands-exist)' passes; the describe-golden script is regenerated only if its output changed; make self-check passes.
fields.statement: The builtin build workflow's builder prompt is the one line `/rhiza-builder Build leaf {leaf} of change set {change} ({title}), attempt {attempt}: follow rhiza guide builder.` and its verifier prompt, and review.toml's leaf verifier prompt, the one line `/rhiza-verifier Verify leaf {leaf} of change set {change} ({title}) at commit $RHIZA_COMMIT: follow rhiza guide verifier.`; Rhiza's .rhiza/workflows/docs-build.toml uses the builder line plus its unchanged doc-prose addendum and the verifier line byte for byte, and .rhiza/workflows/docs-review.toml's leaf verifier prompt is the verifier line byte for byte.
